description: This file contains test definitions and test suite configurations for Playwright tests, utilizing the Playwright testing framework. It defines multiple test cases, hooks, and configurations, as well as interactions with external modules such as '@playwright/test' and custom fixtures.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite with optional configuration (parallel, serial, skip, fixme, only).

methods.name: test.beforeEach
methods.description: Hook executed before each test in a suite.

methods.name: test.afterEach
methods.description: Hook executed after each test in a suite.

methods.name: test.beforeAll
methods.description: Hook executed before all tests in a suite.

methods.name: test.afterAll
methods.description: Hook executed after all tests in a suite.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case, with optional configuration like skip, fixme, only, and test-specific tags.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion library used for validating test outcomes, including extensions with custom matchers.

methods.name: test.describe.configure
methods.description: Configures mode or retries for a test suite.

methods.name: test.step
methods.description: Defines a test step, which can have a return type that is inherited.

methods.name: test.skip
methods.description: Defines a skipped test or suite.

methods.name: test.fixme
methods.description: Marks a test or suite as expected to be fixed or skipped.

methods.name: test.fail
methods.description: Marks a test as expected to fail.

methods.name: test.only
methods.description: Runs only this test or suite.
